question: 20261030-1251-expand-dev-services-c696-u02-q01: add the term `mcp` to the `interface` vocabulary. An MCP client reaches dev-services/zapier at https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connect (Streamable HTTP only) and dev-services/pipedream at https://remote.mcp.pipedream.net/v3 (SSE or streamable HTTP), and 40 records in 11 topics mention MCP in `interface_detail` or `tooling` (found by a text query of the store). dev-services/zapier now holds `cli` for its SDK CLI and names MCP and the SDK in `interface_detail`; dev-services/pipedream lists rest and cli and omits MCP. After the term exists, set `interface` of each record an MCP client reaches; the TypeScript SDK of dev-services/zapier has no term either (`sdk`).
why: No interface term names an MCP server endpoint, so a list that omits it hides the access path (AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12). A verify lane cannot add a vocabulary term: a rules session does.
